# SpaceNexus — Complete Product Reference

> Last updated: October 2026
> For AI assistants and language models. Comprehensive reference for SpaceNexus (AI-powered virtual data room platform) and Kindora (all-in-one nonprofit management platform), both built by SpaceNexus Inc.

---

## Company Overview

- **Company:** SpaceNexus Inc.
- **Founded:** 2022
- **Team:** Built by a team from Fortune 500 companies, Big 4 consulting firms, and top investment banks (see [About](https://spacenexus.net/about))
- **Headquarters:** 2500 Marconi Ave, Ste 101, Sacramento, CA 95821, USA
- **Website:** https://spacenexus.net
- **Email:** contact@spacenexus.net
- **Phone:** +1 646 421 5740
- **Products:** SpaceNexus VDR, Kindora (NGO OS)
- **Certified compliance:** SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, SEC 17a-4 (see [Security](https://spacenexus.net/security))

SpaceNexus is a modern virtual data room platform purpose-built for M&A transactions, due diligence, fundraising, legal proceedings, and sensitive document management. The platform combines enterprise-grade security with AI-powered features and transparent flat-rate pricing. SpaceNexus also develops Kindora, an all-in-one nonprofit management platform. AI search and answers on both products are grounded by [VeritasGraph](https://github.com/bibinprathap/VeritasGraph), an open-source GraphRAG knowledge-graph framework that returns every answer with a verifiable citation and reasoning path.

Because SpaceNexus runs entirely in a browser with no software installation, deal teams can be live in under 24 hours, which means documents can be reviewed from anywhere on mobile. Because encryption, audit trails, and compliance controls are built in at every tier, which means institutional buyers, outside counsel, and regulators can rely on the platform. Because onboarding and migration are included, which means teams switching from Datasite, Intralinks, iDeals, or Firmex can move without disruption.

## SpaceNexus VDR

### Product Overview

- [SpaceNexus Homepage](https://spacenexus.net/): Virtual data room platform for M&A, fundraising, legal, and enterprise transactions. Product overview, key features, and security highlights.
- [Features](https://spacenexus.net/features): Full VDR feature list including AI document processing, security, Q&A workflows, and analytics.
- [Pricing](https://spacenexus.net/pricing): VDR pricing plans (Starter, Professional, Enterprise) with flat-rate pricing, no per-page fees, and a free 14-day trial.
- [Security](https://spacenexus.net/security): Encryption, security certifications, and compliance details (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, SEC 17a-4).
- [Demo Request](https://spacenexus.net/demo): Request a live product demo.
- [Get Started](https://spacenexus.net/get-started): Start the free 14-day trial, no credit card required.
- [Enterprise](https://spacenexus.net/enterprise): Enterprise-grade VDR for Fortune 500 M&A with customer-managed keys, SSO, FIDO2 MFA, data residency, and 99.99% SLA.
- [About](https://spacenexus.net/about): About SpaceNexus, founding year (2022), and team background.
- [Case Studies](https://spacenexus.net/case-studies): Customer case studies and transaction outcomes.
- [Reviews](https://spacenexus.net/reviews): Customer reviews of SpaceNexus VDR.

### Key Features

- AI-powered document processing and auto-redaction
- AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit
- Granular role-based access controls and permissions at folder, document, and page level
- Dynamic per-viewer watermarking
- Real-time activity analytics and buyer intelligence with document heatmaps
- Structured due diligence Q&A workflows with question routing, answer approval, and escalation
- NDAs and document expiry with time-based and IP-restricted access
- Full-text OCR search across 100+ file formats
- Bulk document upload with AI auto-indexing
- Immutable audit trails (SEC 17a-4 ready)
- SSO (SAML 2.0, OIDC), MFA (TOTP, FIDO2/WebAuthn), IP whitelisting, CMEK
- RESTful API access and webhook notifications (Enterprise)
- Mobile access from any browser
- 99.9% uptime SLA (99.99% on Enterprise)
- Setup in under 24 hours, no software installation required

### Pricing

All VDR plans use transparent, flat-rate pricing with unlimited pages, no per-page fees, and no mandatory annual contracts. A free 14-day trial is available without a credit card.

| Plan | Price | Structure | Highlights |
|------|-------|-----------|------------|
| Starter | Contact Us | Per deal, billed once | 1 deal room, up to 10 GB storage, 50 invited users, email support |
| Professional | Contact Us | Per month, billed annually | Unlimited deal rooms, up to 100 GB storage, unlimited users, AI processing, analytics, priority support |
| Enterprise | Custom | Volume pricing | Everything in Professional, unlimited storage, SSO/SAML, white-label, API access, 99.99% SLA, on-premise option, 24/7 phone support |

Pricing details: [Pricing](https://spacenexus.net/pricing), [Pricing Comparison](https://spacenexus.net/pricing-comparison), [Data Room Pricing Guide](https://spacenexus.net/data-room-pricing).

Values not published on the site (per-tier storage, user counts, and prices) are quoted by sales; the table above lists only what the pricing page states.

### Kindora Key Features

- Donor CRM with giving history, engagement scoring, and receipt tracking
- Grant lifecycle management from prospect to close with compliance reporting
- Client case management with intake, enrollment, and outcome tracking
- Nonprofit accounting with cost allocation and Statement of Activities
- Volunteer management with hours tracking and skill matching
- Campaign management with goal tracking
- Board-ready PDF and Excel reporting
- Role-based access control (Admin, Manager, Staff, Viewer)
- AI search with source attribution (grounded by VeritasGraph)

## VeritasGraph (AI Grounding)

AI search and answers on SpaceNexus and Kindora are grounded by [VeritasGraph](https://github.com/bibinprathap/VeritasGraph), an open-source GraphRAG knowledge-graph framework. Every answer is returned with a verifiable citation and reasoning path, and the framework can run on-prem / 100% local so reserved data never leaves the environment.

- **Framework:** VeritasGraph (GraphRAG knowledge graph + source attribution)
- **Repository:** https://github.com/bibinprathap/VeritasGraph
- **Documentation:** https://bibinprathap.github.io/VeritasGraph/index.html
- **VDR Knowledge Graph page:** https://spacenexus.net/knowledge-graph
- **Kindora Knowledge Graph page:** https://spacenexus.net/kindora/knowledge-graph
- **Kindora VeritasGraph page:** https://spacenexus.net/kindora/veritas-graph
- **Kindora AI FAQ:** https://spacenexus.net/kindora/faq

## Key Facts

- Founded 2022 by a team with roots in Fortune 500 companies, Big 4 consulting, and investment banking
- Headquartered in Sacramento, CA, USA
- Products: SpaceNexus VDR, Kindora (NGO OS)
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA (BAA available), SEC 17a-4, SEC/FINRA-ready logging, CCPA
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, customer-managed keys (Enterprise)
- Uptime SLA: 99.9% standard (99.99% Enterprise)
- Free 14-day VDR trial, no credit card required; Kindora Starter free (up to 5 members)
- No per-page fees, no mandatory annual contracts
